rationale: The assistant correctly identified normal cooling-fan run-on on a combi microwave ('it is cooling the magnetron and, after combi/grill use, the hot internal parts'), matching the hidden truth, and sensibly noted the old solo model is not a fair comparison. It set the right boundary for when it would be a fault ('runs indefinitely, starts while the oven has been idle... hot/burning smell') and correctly steered away from DIY on a microwave. It did not ask the expected confirming questions (does it stop by itself, longer after grill) and did not mention the Samsung warranty route, so question quality and overall are slightly short of excellent, but the homeowner is well served with a single accurate reply.
